$comment: The Ashmorrow realm's launcher manifest. The website serves this at
/api/launcher/manifest, filling the realm address in from its own
environment so this file never has to know a deployment's hostname.
client.files is EMPTY, and that is the honest current state: hashes have
to be measured against a real 3.3.5a client, and nobody has done that
yet. Until they are, the launcher checks structure and build number, and
says in its own interface that it has nothing to compare contents with.
To fill it in, from a machine that has a client:
then paste build, version, locales and files in here, and record where
the copy came from in measured_from. The output is paths, sizes and
hashes - facts, safe to commit and publish. No client bytes leave the
machine that runs it, and none are ever committed here.
